ATTIO MCP SERVER

Connect your AI tools to Attio via Model Context Protocol.

SETUP
-----

**For Claude Desktop or Claude.ai:**

1. Open Settings -> Connectors -> Browse connectors
2. Search for Attio
3. Install Attio

**For ChatGPT:**

1. Open Apps
2. Search for Attio
3. Connect Attio

**For other MCP clients:**

Add `https://mcp.attio.com/mcp` as a remote MCP server and complete
the OAuth authentication when prompted.

RESOURCES

Documentation    https://docs.attio.com/mcp/overview
